system.description:
You generate multiple small floating globes of lightning chakra that you fire at a target. Make a ranged Ninjutsu attack. On a hit, the target creature takes 3d6 lightning damage. Once per casting, all creatures in a 60-foot, 5 feet wide line between you and the target creature must make a dexterity saving throw taking 2d6 lightning damage and gaining 1 rank of Shaken on a failed save and half as much on a success.

Overcharge. You create a second set of lightning globes, and you must select a second creature to target with this jutsu.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the damage dealt by 1d6 for both the attack and save effect.
